acceptance_gates.component_coefficients: pRT/Gray component vectors are checked by the native ROBERT/pRT comparison; John (1988) is diagnostic only

poseidon_john_1988_diagnostic.expected_physical_differences: John uses the 1.6421 um BF threshold and point values. ROBERT uses the pRT Gray threshold and pRT-compatible bin averages when frequency-bin edges are available. The selected long-wave FF polynomial is an independent fit, so small coefficient differences are expected. No full FF upper validity range is claimed here.
poseidon_john_1988_diagnostic.free_free_unit: cm^4 dyne^-1 before p_e; cm^2 per H particle after p_e
poseidon_john_1988_diagnostic.source: John (1988), Continuous absorption by the negative hydrogen ion reconsidered
